name: TabStop
description: Represents a single tab stop. The TabStop object is a member of the TabStops collection. The TabStops collection represents all the custom and default tab stops in a paragraph or group of paragraphs.
remarks: Use TabStops (Index), where Index is the location of the tab stop (in points) or the index number, to return a single TabStop object. Tab stops are indexed numerically from left to right along the ruler. The following example removes the first custom tab stop from the selected paragraphs. The following example adds a right-aligned tab stop positioned at 2 inches to the selected paragraphs. Use the Add method to add a tab stop. The following example adds two tab stops to the selected paragraphs. The first tab stop is a left-aligned tab with a dotted tab leader positioned at 1 inch (72 points). The second tab stop is centered and is positioned at 2 inches. You can also add a tab stop by specifying a location with the TabStops property. The following example adds a right-aligned tab stop positioned at 2 inches to the selected paragraphs.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified TabStop object.

properties.name: Alignment
properties.description: Returns or sets a WdTabAlignment constant that represents the alignment for the specified tab stop. Read/write.

properties.name: Leader
properties.description: Returns or sets the leader for the specified TabStop object. Read/write WdTabLeader.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of a tab stop relative to the left margin. Read/write Single.

properties.name: CustomTab
properties.description: True if the specified tab stop is a custom tab stop. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: Next
properties.description: Returns the next tabstop in the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Previous
properties.description: Returns the previous tab stop in the collection. Read-only.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes the specified custom tab stop.
